$comment: Error codes shared by the LISA server and its clients. scripts/generate-api-contract.mjs turns this file into src/web/error-codes.generated.ts and the Swift LisaErrorCode enum in packaging/ios-companion/Sources/APIContract.generated.swift. Run `npm run generate:api-contract` after editing it.

shape.http: Every non-2xx response on /api/*, /chat and /events has a JSON body {"error": "<code>", "message": "<one sentence a person can act on>"}. Route-specific fields such as reason, retryAfterSec, resetAt, tier, suggestion and ok:false stay alongside them.
shape.sse: A chat turn that fails after the stream opened sends {"type": "error", "code": "<code>", "message": "..."}.
shape.codes: error is a stable snake_case code. A response whose route gives no specific code uses the generic code for its HTTP status (fallbackByStatus). Clients must treat a code they don't know as unknown and fall back to the HTTP status and message.
shape.message: Written for the person using the app. It may differ between server versions and editions; never parse it.

codes.when: No valid credential: the session is missing, expired, signed out or revoked. reason says which (token_missing, token_mismatch, account_session_required, server_not_configured). Sign in again.
codes.message: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

codes.when: The route needs a signed-in LISA account, not a shared or device token.
codes.message: Sign in to your Lisa account to do this.

codes.when: The account's free allowance for the current window is used up. resetAt (epoch ms) and tier are included. Buying credits helps.
codes.message: You've used your free allowance for now. Add credits to keep going, or wait for it to reset.

codes.when: The selected model needs a paid balance. Buying credits or choosing another model helps.
codes.message: This model needs credits on your account. Add credits or choose another model.

codes.when: LISA Cloud stopped new AI requests for everyone: an operator pause, the global daily cap, or the cap counter being unreadable. Buying credits does not help.
codes.message: LISA Cloud has paused new requests for now. Please try again later.

codes.when: An operator suspended this account.
codes.message: This account is suspended. Contact Lisa support for help.

codes.when: An operator turned this model off.
codes.message: This model isn't available right now. Choose another model.

codes.when: Hosted Lisa refuses machine-level routes (push, dispatch, mail, devices and similar). profile names the capability profile.
codes.message: Hosted Lisa can't do this. Connect your Mac to use it.

codes.when: The Mac's control policy has remoteControl off, so a phone or other remote device can't drive its agents.
codes.message: Remote control is turned off on your Mac. Turn it on in Lisa on the Mac, then try again.

codes.when: The Mac's control policy has remoteAdoptExternal off, so a remote device can't take over sessions started outside Lisa.
codes.message: Taking over outside sessions from another device is turned off on your Mac. Turn it on in Lisa on the Mac, then try again.

codes.when: Only the person at the Mac (a localhost request) may do this.
codes.message: Only someone at the Mac can do this. Do it in Lisa on the Mac.

codes.when: A loopback request named a foreign Host header without a valid token (a tunnel or proxy without a token, or DNS rebinding).
codes.message: Your Mac doesn't trust this address. Connect with its access token or pairing code instead.

codes.when: Generic code for a 403 without a specific one.
codes.message: You don't have permission to do that.

codes.when: Another turn is still running for this account or agent. retryAfterSec is included where known.
codes.message: Lisa is still answering your last message. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

codes.when: Too many requests from this account or address. retryAfterSec says when to retry.
codes.message: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment, then try again.

codes.when: A sign-in code was just sent to this address. retryAfterSec says when another can be requested.
codes.message: A code was just sent. Check your inbox, or wait a moment before asking for another.

codes.when: Too many sign-in codes were sent to this address today. retryAfterSec is included.
codes.message: Too many codes were sent to this address today. Try again tomorrow.

codes.when: An operator switched this feature off on LISA Cloud.
codes.message: This feature is turned off for now. Try again later.

codes.when: Balance or quota storage could not be read; nothing was charged.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't check your balance just now. Try again in a moment.

codes.when: The account directory could not be read or written.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't reach your account just now. Try again in a moment.

codes.when: This account is being deleted.
codes.message: This account is being deleted.

codes.when: The conversation named in the request no longer exists.
codes.message: That conversation no longer exists. Start a new one.

codes.when: POST /api/billing/iap: the signed transaction could not be read. Body has ok:false.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't read this purchase. Restore purchases and try again.

codes.when: POST /api/billing/iap: the purchase carries no appAccountToken for a LISA account. Body has ok:false.
codes.message: This purchase isn't linked to your Lisa account. Restore purchases while signed in.

codes.when: POST /api/billing/iap: the purchase belongs to a different LISA account. Body has ok:false.
codes.message: This purchase belongs to a different Lisa account. Sign in to that account to use it.

codes.when: POST /api/billing/iap: Apple's certificate chain did not verify. Body has ok:false.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't verify this purchase with Apple. Try again later.

codes.when: POST /api/billing/iap: the transaction signature did not verify. Body has ok:false.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't verify this purchase with Apple. Try again later.

codes.when: POST /api/billing/iap: the purchase was made in a different app. Body has ok:false.
codes.message: This purchase wasn't made in Lisa. Buy credits from Lisa itself.

codes.when: POST /api/billing/iap: the product id is not one LISA sells. Body has ok:false.
codes.message: Lisa doesn't sell this item anymore. Update the app and try again.

codes.when: POST /api/billing/iap: a sandbox (test) purchase reached LISA Cloud from an account that may not use one. Body has ok:false.
codes.message: Test purchases can't add credits. Buy credits from the App Store version of Lisa.

codes.when: POST /api/billing/iap: Apple has no record of this transaction. Body has ok:false.
codes.message: Apple has no record of this purchase. Restore purchases and try again.

codes.when: POST /api/billing/iap: Apple's root certificate could not be loaded, so nothing could be verified. Body has ok:false.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't verify purchases just now. Try again later.

codes.when: POST /api/billing/iap: verification failed for another reason. Body has ok:false.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't verify this purchase. Try again later.

codes.when: Sign in with Apple or Google: the identity token did not verify. reason carries the detail.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't verify that sign-in. Try again.

codes.when: This sign-in method is off or not set up on this server.
codes.message: This sign-in method isn't available here. Choose another way to sign in.

codes.when: This server only admits listed Apple IDs.
codes.message: This Apple ID can't sign in to this Lisa server.

codes.when: POST /api/auth/apple without identityToken.
codes.message: Sign-in didn't finish. Try again.

codes.when: POST /api/auth/google without idToken.
codes.message: Sign-in didn't finish. Try again.

codes.when: POST /api/auth/apple without the replay nonce this server requires.
codes.message: Update Lisa, then sign in again.

codes.when: Email accounts and codes exist only on LISA Cloud.
codes.message: Accounts aren't available on this Lisa server.

codes.when: Creating or signing in to the account failed on the server.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't finish signing you in. Try again in a moment.

codes.when: Email and password do not match.
codes.message: That email and password don't match. Try again, or sign in with a code instead.

codes.when: Too many failed password attempts for this address; locked for 15 minutes.
codes.message: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait 15 minutes, or sign in with a code instead.

codes.when: The address is not a valid email address.
codes.message: Enter a valid email address.

codes.when: The password is shorter than 8 or longer than 256 characters.
codes.message: Use a password of at least 8 characters.

codes.when: Registering an address that already has an account.
codes.message: An account already uses this email. Sign in instead.

codes.when: Registering with a throwaway-mail domain.
codes.message: Use an email address you keep, not a temporary one.

codes.when: The anti-abuse check on registration failed.
codes.message: The security check didn't pass. Try again.

codes.when: The address looks mistyped; suggestion holds the likely fix.
codes.message: That email address looks mistyped. Check it and try again.

codes.when: Mail cannot be delivered to the address's domain.
codes.message: Mail can't be delivered to that address. Check it and try again.

codes.when: The sign-in code is wrong.
codes.message: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.

codes.when: The sign-in code has expired.
codes.message: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.

codes.when: No sign-in code is outstanding for this address.
codes.message: Ask for a sign-in code first.

codes.when: Too many wrong sign-in codes; the code is used up.
codes.message: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.

codes.when: Only email accounts have an address to verify.
codes.message: Only email accounts need verifying.

codes.when: Chat stream: the AI model provider failed. On LISA Cloud the message is generic and the detail is only logged; on a Mac (the owner's own key) the message is the provider's detail.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't answer right now. Try again in a moment.

codes.when: Chat stream: the turn failed for a reason other than the model provider. On LISA Cloud the message is generic; on a Mac it carries the detail.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't finish that reply. Try again in a moment.

codes.when: Generic code for a 400 without a specific one.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't understand that request. Update the app and try again.

codes.when: Generic code for a 402 without a specific one.
codes.message: This needs credits on your account.

codes.when: Generic code for a 404 without a specific one, including routes this server doesn't have.
codes.message: That isn't available on this Lisa server.

codes.when: Generic code for a 405.
codes.message: That isn't available on this Lisa server.

codes.when: Generic code for a 408.
codes.message: The request took too long. Try again.

codes.when: Generic code for a 409 without a specific one.
codes.message: That changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.

codes.when: Generic code for a 410.
codes.message: That is no longer available.

codes.when: The request body is over the route's limit; limitBytes is included.
codes.message: That's too large to send. Try a smaller file or message.

codes.when: The request was not sent as application/json.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't read that request. Update the app and try again.

codes.when: Generic code for a 416.
codes.message: That part of the file isn't available.

codes.when: Generic code for a 422.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't process that request. Check it and try again.

codes.when: Generic code for a 500.
codes.message: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.

codes.when: Generic code for a 501.
codes.message: This Lisa server can't do that yet. Update Lisa and try again.

codes.when: Generic code for a 502.
codes.message: Lisa couldn't reach a service it relies on. Try again in a moment.

codes.when: Generic code for a 503 without a specific one.
codes.message: Lisa is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

codes.when: Generic code for a 504.
codes.message: A service Lisa relies on took too long. Try again in a moment.

codes.when: Generic code for any other non-2xx status.
codes.message: The request didn't work. Try again in a moment.
